the design and analysis of software for embedded processors.
embedded software and its analysis, verification, and testing.

there is a large growth in the number of embedded systems, and that the growth is being driven by both application and technological forces.
the number of embedded processors is growing rapidly and that they are increasingly being used as the primary computational element.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are seeing an increasing number of application specific systems being implemented as software running on general purpose processors.
we have developed a methodology and a tool for power analysis of embedded software, and have used this tool for power analysis and optimization of a number of embedded software applications.
we have developed a methodology for the analysis of the performance of software on an embedded processor, and have developed a tool that implements this methodology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
power analysis is a necessary step for the successful design of embedded software and hardware.
it is not sufficient to have a good design of the hardware and the embedded software.
it is possible to do power aware design at the system level.
